sponsored.t: Relates to license fees required to be paid by wholesale beer licensees to sell cider
sponsored.sum: Requires wholesale beer licensees to only need to pay a one time additional license fee to sell cider.

sponsored.t: Allows licensees to sell wine or liquor at retail to certain other licensees for resale for consumption off the premises
sponsored.sum: Allows licensees to sell wine or liquor at retail for consumption off the premises to certain other licensees; allows such other licensees to resell such wine or liquor for consumption off the premises.

sponsored.t: Relates to the adoption of a good cause for disapproval standard for certain off-premises retail licenses
sponsored.sum: Relates to the adoption of a good cause for disapproval standard for certain off-premises retail licenses by the liquor authority.

sponsored.t: Grants peace officer status to security officers employed by St. Joseph's Health Hospital, North Medical Center and Northeast Medical Center
sponsored.sum: Grants peace officer status to security officers employed by St. Joseph's Health Hospital, North Medical Center and Northeast Medical Center when acting pursuant to their special duties on the grounds or premises owned, controlled or administered by any such hospital or any of its subsidiaries.

sponsored.t: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises to 2027
sponsored.sum: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises from June 30, 2026 to June 30, 2027; extends for one year the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises which is tasked with reporting and making recommendations on how best to support such businesses and promote the formation and growth of new employee-owned enterprises in New York state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes licensees to remain open for extended hours of operation statewide for a specific period of time
sponsored.sum: Authorizes licensees to remain open for extended hours of operation statewide between June 11 and July 20, 2026.

sponsored.t: Requires the director of the division of minority and women's business development in the department of economic development to give additional time for a business enterprise to cure defects
sponsored.sum: Requires the director of the division of minority and women's business development in the department of economic development to give additional time for a business enterprise to cure defects in its application for certification or correct defects when a certification is denied, revoked, or changed.

sponsored.t: Establishes a stakeholder group in the Oswego river basin
sponsored.sum: Establishes a stakeholder group in the Oswego river basin to coordinate water release.

sponsored.t: Provides for the sale of salvaged airbags; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides for the sale of recycled inflatable restraint systems; allows for the sale of non-deployed recycled inflatable restraint systems in New York, provided that such inflatable restraint systems meet required safety standards.

sponsored.t: Enacts the NYS PPE resilience & manufacturing act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the NYS PPE resilience & manufacturing act under which state-funded health care entities are required to purchase PPE manufactured in New York state for all contracts exceeding fifty thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing certain sales of private label wine
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain restaurants to sell sealed bottles of private label wine for off-premises consumption with the purchase of a substantial food item.

sponsored.t: Requires every college and university to provide public notice of cessation of operation and to develop transition plans for shared services
sponsored.sum: Requires every college and university to provide public notice of cessation of operation and to develop transition plans for shared services with local governments, agencies, or not-for-profit corporations.

sponsored.t: Creates a special on-premises license for certain properties
sponsored.sum: Creates a special on-premises license for properties which are located within a designated industrial or economic zoning district, occupy not less than twenty thousand square feet of floor area, and are located at least 500 feet from a residential building.

sponsored.t: Relates to financial assistance to small businesses for the purpose of pollution prevention, control and compliance
sponsored.sum: Relates to financial assistance to small businesses for the purpose of pollution prevention, control and compliance.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "honesty in cut meat act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "honesty in cut meat act" under which grocery stores must display signage that distinguishes between store-cut meat and pre-cut, pre-packaged meat.

sponsored.t: Requires transmitters of money to provide a certain warning to consumers
sponsored.sum: Requires transmitters of money to provide a warning which informs consumers of certain fraudulent activities that may occur.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the department of public service to conduct a study on the deployment of energy interconnection processes into the electrical grid
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the department of public service to conduct a study on the deployment of energy interconnection processes into the electrical grid to meet the state's renewable energy goals; directs the department of public service to submit a report on its findings one year after the effective date.

sponsored.t: Increases transparency in certain film production and post-production tax credits
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of economic development issue a quarterly report on film production and post-production tax credits by project and by county in the aggregate and publish such reports on such department's website.

sponsored.t: Establishes the gallon as the standard measurement for purposes of taxation of alcoholic beverages
sponsored.sum: Establishes the gallon as the standard measurement for purposes of taxation of alcoholic beverages.

sponsored.t: Establishes a low potency cannabis beverage retail permit
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the issuance of a low potency cannabis beverage retail permit to licensed off-premises liquor and wine stores to allow the regulated sale of low potency cannabis single use beverages that contain no more than 5mg of THC manufactured by New York state adult-use licensees; provides for the allocation of low potency cannabis beverage tax revenue in the New York state cannabis revenue fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the earnings limitation for positions of public service
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the earnings limitation for positions of public service; increases the earnings limitation from $35,000 to $65,000 in 2027 and thereafter.

sponsored.t: Requires polls for special town elections to open on otherwise scheduled general election days
sponsored.sum: Requires polls for special town elections to open on otherwise scheduled general election days, as designated by the state board of elections.

sponsored.t: Expands the ability of certain persons who sell alcohol to set the price of said alcohol
sponsored.sum: Expands the ability of certain persons who sell alcohol to set the price of said alcohol.

sponsored.t: Relates to technical assistance provided to municipalities related to college and university closures; repealer
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of economic development to provide certain assistance to municipalities in which a college or university has closed.

sponsored.t: Allowing new buildings where new parking is provided to have an optional, charger-agnostic, power-based allocation method alternative to certain electric vehicle charging infrastructure requirements
sponsored.sum: Allows new buildings where new parking is provided to have an optional, charger-agnostic, power-based allocation method alternative to certain electric vehicle charging infrastructure requirements; requires the department of state division of building standards and codes to promulgate rules and regulations relating to such alternative.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "food retail establishment subsidization for healthy communities act"
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "food retail establishment subsidization for healthy communities act" (FRESH Communities); provides loans, loan guarantees, interest subsidies and grants to businesses, municipalities, not-for-profit corporations or local development corporations for the purpose of attracting, maintaining or permitting the expansion of food retail establishments in underserved areas.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of New York state labelled beer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of New York state labelled beer; provides that a licensed farm brewery shall manufacture or sell New York state labelled beer and may manufacture or sell beer other than New York state labelled beer that the licensee has manufactured provided that certain conditions are met.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing loan forgiveness to CASACs
sponsored.sum: Provides loan forgiveness to credentialed alcoholism and substance abuse counselors (CASACs) who reside in the state and work in a facility licensed by the state.

sponsored.t: Allows the New York state thruway authority to provide a discounted toll rate to farmers transporting agricultural products
sponsored.sum: Allows the New York state thruway authority to provide a discounted toll rate to farmers transporting agricultural products.

sponsored.t: Allows school districts to permit home-schooled students to participate in district interscholastic sports
sponsored.sum: Allows school districts to permit home-schooled students to participate in district interscholastic sports.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting certain public school buildings from being designated as early polling locations
sponsored.sum: Exempts public school buildings with instructional space from being designated as early polling locations; allows school districts to decline school building designations as early polling locations.

sponsored.t: Establishes the hire a vet grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the hire a vet grant program; provides grants to municipalities where a veteran is hired and employed, for not less than twelve continuous and uninterrupted months in a full-time or part-time position.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a veteran's close friend or family member who is reasonably familiar with such veteran's wishes to request that such veteran be buried in a state veterans' cemetery
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a veteran's close friend or family who is reasonably familiar with such veteran's wishes to request that such veteran be buried in a state veterans' cemetery.

sponsored.t: Relates to the approval of policy forms
sponsored.sum: Identifies certain group policies, group contracts and certificates issued thereunder exempting them from filing and approval requirements.

sponsored.t: Establishes the sustainable communities fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the sustainable communities fund; authorizes grants to municipal corporations who meet certain requirements for eligible projects that incorporate smart growth principles or utilize climate resilient and environmentally friendly construction techniques.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of taxation and finance to study and to make recommendations regarding the frequency of residents who are being assessed library taxes for more than one library
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of taxation and finance to study the frequency of residents who are being assessed library taxes for more than one library and to make recommendations to address the double taxation of residents.

sponsored.t: Establishes temporary health care staffing agencies
sponsored.sum: Establishes temporary health care staffing agencies to assist qualified health care professionals to find temporary employment at health care facilities.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance companies to provide at least ninety days of rehabilitation services to an insured upon a doctor's prescription
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance companies to provide at least ninety days of rehabilitation services to an insured upon a doctor's prescription.

sponsored.t: Establishes the green building credit for construction or rehabilitation of property in conformity with certain energy efficiency standards
sponsored.sum: Establishes the green building credit for construction or rehabilitation of property in conformity with certain energy efficiency standards.

sponsored.t: Relates to school session days
sponsored.sum: Relates to school session days; adds general election day to the list of days when school will not be in session; allows a school district to elect to require staff attendance on a general election day or to schedule a professional development day.

sponsored.t: Relates to licensure requirements for fiscal intermediaries; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to licensure requirements for fiscal intermediaries.

sponsored.t: Provides an insurance premium reduction for landscape businesses whose employees complete a safety course for the landscape industry
sponsored.sum: Provides an insurance premium reduction for landscape businesses whose employees complete a safety course for the landscape industry.

sponsored.t: Provides that a fire company may elect to include call firefighters within its membership who shall receive a stipend for each call that he or she responds to
sponsored.sum: Provides that a fire company may elect to include call firefighters within its membership who shall receive a stipend for each call that such firefighter responds to.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to develop a public awareness campaign promoting businesses located in New York state
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to develop a public awareness campaign promoting businesses located in New York state with an emphasis on small businesses and the need to shop in downtown local areas; requires the creation of the Buy New York Online Networking Directory to connect purchasers with businesses located in New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to membership on the cannabis control board and the cannabis advisory board
sponsored.sum: Increases membership on the cannabis control board and the cannabis advisory board.

sponsored.t: Allows school districts to permit home-schooled students to attend career education classes
sponsored.sum: Allows school districts to permit home-schooled students to attend career education classes.

sponsored.t: Relates to rules and regulations for advertising and marketing of cannabis
sponsored.sum: Requires the promulgation of rules and regulations for advertising and marketing of cannabis that include, but are not limited to, signage on the exterior walls or windows of licensed retail dispensaries; signage in languages other than English; lighting in colors other than white; other such advertising measures.

sponsored.t: Relates to pass-through manufacturers zero percent tax rate
sponsored.sum: Relates to pass-through manufacturers zero percent tax rate; extends a zero percent franchise tax to all manufacturers.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for homeowners and businesses to build permeable surfaces
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for homeowners and businesses to build permeable surfaces.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "microbusiness resiliency and growth act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "microbusiness resiliency and growth act"; defines "microbusiness" as a business employing five or fewer persons, is resident in this state, is independently owned and operated, is not dominant in its field, and does not conduct its business transactions primarily over the internet; further provides for a segregated sales tax system for such microbusinesses.

sponsored.t: Relates to the term "income" for purposes of the school tax relief exemption
sponsored.sum: Relates to the term "income" for purposes of the school tax relief exemption; adds 401(k) and 403(b) accounts to the list of eligible income deductions when determining Enhanced STAR eligibility.

sponsored.t: Establishes a small business tax credit for salary and wages paid to employees for time spent at sexual harassment prevention training
sponsored.sum: Establishes a small business tax credit for salary and wages paid to employees for time spent at sexual harassment prevention training.

sponsored.t: Creates the mobile high-technology training facilities program
sponsored.sum: Creates the mobile high-technology training facilities program to award one to one matching grants on a competitive basis to qualified applicants for the design, development and/or outfit of mobile high-technology training facilities that complement certificate, degree or other recognized credentialing programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal possession of stolen property
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the court where there is criminal possession of stolen property to, in its discretion release the principal pending trial on the principal's own recognizance or under non-monetary conditions, fix bail, or order non-monetary conditions in conjunction with fixing bail, or, where the defendant is charged with a qualifying offense which is a felony, the court may commit the principal to the custody of the sheriff; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "bucks for boilers act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the bucks for boilers act, which creates a program to aid in transition of housing units to electric heat pumps and other high energy efficiency upgrades.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding New York's manufacturing tax incentive to S corporations
sponsored.sum: Relates to expanding New York's manufacturing tax incentive to S corporations which are qualified New York state manufacturers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the sale of non-alcoholic versions of alcoholic beverages by licensees
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the sale of non-alcoholic versions of alcoholic beverages by licensees and wholesalers; defines non-alcoholic versions of alcoholic beverages.

sponsored.t: Limits the department of environmental conservation's ability to fix special open seasons for taking wild deer
sponsored.sum: Limits the department of environmental conservation's ability to fix special open seasons for taking wild deer to ending no later than the 3rd Sunday of December of each year; allows the department to issue regulations for special seasons for particular counties or designated wildlife management units after consultation with local governments and stakeholders.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York brewery empowerment and economic revitalization credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York brewery empowerment and economic revitalization credit in the amount of seven cents per gallon of beer produced in the state; sets eligibility criteria; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary New York craft beverage permit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary New York craft beverage permit for all New York state manufactured liquor, spirits, wine, beer, cider and mead for events located in a municipality with a population of less than one million.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain fees from being imposed by licensed wholesalers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain fees from being imposed by licensed wholesalers on licensed retailers.

sponsored.t: Creates the Oak Orchard wastewater project
sponsored.sum: Creates the Oak Orchard wastewater project; provides that Onondaga county, within certain requirements and only when a project labor agreement is performed, the county may utilize the alternative delivery method referred to as a design-build contract for a project.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing timeframes for the payment of claims to hospitals
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing timeframes for the payment of claims to hospitals.

sponsored.t: Establishes a cannabis processor tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a cannabis processor tax credit; authorizes a tax credit that is the equivalent to the licensed processor's cannabis potency tax liability for the year two thousand twenty-three, multiplied by three, but shall not exceed four hundred thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of public service, in conjunction with other agencies to commission a study on the utilization of directional noise reduction optimization technology for wind turbines in New York state
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of public service, in conjunction with the New York state energy research and development authority, and the power authority of the state of New York to commission a study on the utilization of directional noise reduction optimization technology for wind turbines in New York state.

sponsored.t: Increases the capacity needed to be considered a bottle club
sponsored.sum: Increases the capacity needed to be considered a bottle club from twenty persons to one hundred persons.

sponsored.t: Permits employees of authorized organizations to operate games of chance
sponsored.sum: Permits employees of authorized organizations to operate games of chance.

sponsored.t: Relates to temporary services provided by "health care personnel"
sponsored.sum: Amends the definition of "health care personnel" to define the term "temporary services" as health care services contracted for an initial term of less than twenty-four continuous months; requires a temporary health care services agency to annually submit to the department of health copies of all contracts between the agency and a health care entity to which it assigns or refers health care personnel.

sponsored.t: Relates to a conditional adult-use retail dispensary license
sponsored.sum: Provides for minimum requirements for a conditional adult-use retail dispensary license.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a microbusiness licensee to change their license type to an adult use cannabis cultivation license, upon the approval of the office of cannabis management
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a microbusiness licensee to change their license type to an adult use cannabis cultivation license, upon the approval of the office of cannabis management; directs the office to promulgate regulations allowing a microbusiness licensee to be licensed and operate without opening a retail storefront.

sponsored.t: Imposes limits on where licensed adult use dispensing facilities may be located and waivers from such proximity protection
sponsored.sum: Provides that licensed adult use dispensing facilities shall be no less than 1,000 feet apart in municipalities with a population of 20,000 people or more, and no less than 2,000 feet apart in municipalities with a population of less than 20,000 people; provides proximity protection waivers.

sponsored.t: Establishes a stakeholder group in the Oswego river basin
sponsored.sum: Establishes a stakeholder group in the Oswego river basin to coordinate water release.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 72 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills: Assembly Bill Number 33, entitled: "AN ACT in relation to establishing the task force to promote the employment of people with disabilities" Assembly Bill Number 468, entitled: "AN ACT directing the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study of official inspection stations, safety inspections and fees" Assembly Bill Number 1988-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to establishing a center for technical assistance relating to age-friendly health systems; and in relation to hospital performance data" Assembly Bill Number 2468, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to creating the state office of the utility consumer advocate" Assembly Bill Number 2497, entitled: "AN ACT establishing a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a…

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York state craft beverage industry
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of economic development, in cooperation with the commissioner of agriculture and markets and the state liquor authority to establish procedures for proposing to the governor nominations for annual awards to be known as "New York state liquor retailers awards", "New York state beer retailers awards", "New York state cider retailer awards", and "New York state mead retailers awards"; requires the commissioner of economic development to promote state policies that will encourage the production and sale of New York labelled beers, ciders, liquors, and mead.

sponsored.t: Authorizes private membership establishments to have certain licenses for sale of alcohol
sponsored.sum: Authorizes private membership establishments to have certain licenses for sale of alcohol for consumption on premises.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of law relating to big game hunting authorization for the county of Onondaga
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law relating to big game hunting authorization for the county of Onondaga until October 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises to 2026
sponsored.sum: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises from June 30, 2025 to June 30, 2026; extends for one year the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises which is tasked with reporting and making recommendations on how best to support such businesses and promote the formation and growth of new employee-owned enterprises in New York state.

sponsored.t: Permits certain retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from certain other retail licensees
sponsored.sum: Permits on-premises retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from off-premises retail licensees and off-premises retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from on-premises retail licensees.

sponsored.t: Provides technical assistance to any municipality that has had a college or university close within such municipality
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of state, in cooperation with other departments, to provide technical assistance to any municipality, upon request, that has had a college or university close within such municipality.

sponsored.t: Includes digital health care service platforms in the definition of temporary health care services agency
sponsored.sum: Includes digital health care service platforms in the definition of temporary health care services agency.

sponsored.t: Authorizes private membership establishments to have certain licenses for sale of alcohol
sponsored.sum: Authorizes private membership establishments to have certain licenses for sale of alcohol for consumption on premises; establishes a private membership establishment must include one hundred or more members.

sponsored.t: Relates to fees for a activities undertaken pursuant to a lake program
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the department of environmental conservation from charging any application fee or any other fee for activities undertaken pursuant to a lake program.
